SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT NVL(WERKS,' ') AS PLANT, NVL(EBELN,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, NVL(EBELP,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM ZKEP_PO WHERE iflag = '1'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KA' AS SITE, 'MHWA' AS BUYER, NVL(WERKS,' ') AS PLANT, NVL(EBELN,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, NVL(EBELP,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(STATUS,' ') AS STATUS, NVL(MATNR,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(NETPR*100, 0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(MENGE,0) AS ITEM_QTY, NVL(BRTWR*100,0) AS ITEM_AMT, NVL(AEDAT,' ') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(EINDT,' ') AS RD_DATE, NVL(LGORT,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(UNAME,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, NVL(TXZ01,' ') AS REMARK, '.' AS DESCRIPTION, '.' AS SPECIFICATION, NVL(MEINS,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, NVL(AFNAM,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, NVL(IFLAG,' ') AS IF_FLAG, NVL(IDATE,' ') AS IF_DATE, NVL(ITIME,' ') AS IF_TIME FROM ZKEP_PO WHERE IFLAG = '1' AND WERKS = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND EBELN = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND EBELP = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' ORDER BY WERKS,EBELN,EBELP
UPDATE ZKEP_PO SET IFLAG = '2', IDATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), ITIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE IFLAG = '1' AND WERKS = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND EBELN = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND EBELP = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$'
